priorityList: Keep Shield Block active, refreshing if it has less than 10 seconds remaining.
Use Avatar if the Thunder Blast buff is absent or has 2 or fewer stacks remaining.
Use Ravager and Champion's Spear on cooldown.
Use Demoralizing Shout on cooldown if Booming Voice is talented.
Use Ignore Pain to prevent capping rage, especially when Shield Slam or Shield Charge are about to become available.
Cast Thunder Blast as your highest priority rotational ability.
Cast Shield Slam on cooldown to generate rage.
Cast Thunder Clap if Ravager is active or if Thunder Blast is unavailable.
Cast Execute if Sudden Death procs or if you have at least 40 Rage during the execute phase.
Cast Revenge if you are near maximum rage (80+) or have a free proc.
Use Shattering Throw or Wrecking Throw as a filler if talented into Javelineer.
Use Devastate as a final filler when no other abilities are available.
Use combat racials (like Blood Fury or Berserking) and offensive trinkets during Avatar.
